props.name: options
props.description: The maplibre source specification minus `type`. Applied incrementally on change.

props.name: sourceId
props.description: Id the source is registered under. Layers in the default slot bind to it automatically.

props.name: type
props.description: Source kind. Discriminates `options`.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Rendered once the source is on the map, so nested layers can add themselves immediately.

props.name: layerId
props.description: Layer id on the map.

props.name: type
props.description: Layer kind. Discriminates `options`.

props.name: before
props.description: Insert the layer before this one.

props.name: options
props.description: The maplibre layer specification minus `id`, `type` and `source`. Applied incrementally on change — see `lib/layerDiff.ts`.

props.name: source
props.description: Source id, or a maplibre `Source` instance. Optional inside a `<MglSource>`, which provides it. Only a string id participates in source-readiness tracking.

value.type: (AnimationOptions & CenterZoomBearing & { pitch?: number | undefined; roll?: number | undefined; elevation?: number | undefined; } & { curve?: number | undefined; minZoom?: number | undefined; speed?: number | undefined; screenSpeed?: number | undefined; maxDuration?: number | undefined; padding?: number | PaddingOptions | undefined; } & { linear?: boolean | undefined; offset?: PointLike | undefined; maxZoom?: number | undefined; } & { useOnBoundsUpdate?: boolean | undefined; }) | undefined

slots.name: default
slots.description: Rendered only once the map object exists, so children can assume `map.value` is set.

props.name: source
props.description: Id of a `raster-dem` source.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Custom marker content. Omit it to get maplibre's default pin.

slots.name: popup
slots.description: For a nested `<MglPopup>`; it attaches to this marker rather than to the map.

props.name: coordinates
props.description: Optional when nested in an `<MglMarker>` (the marker's position wins) or with `track-pointer`.

props.name: open
props.description: Two-way: `v-model:open`. Leave unset for an always-open popup.

props.name: trackPointer
props.description: Follow the cursor instead of sticking to a coordinate.

props.name: state
props.description: Values for the style's global state, addressable from expressions via `['global-state', 'key']`. New in maplibre v6.

props.name: id
props.description: Name layers reference in `icon-image` / `fill-pattern` / `line-pattern`.

props.name: image
props.description: Bitmap, `ImageData`, `ImageBitmap`, or a `StyleImageInterface` for a procedural icon.

props.name: light
props.description: The maplibre light specification (`anchor`, `position`, `color`, `intensity`).

props.name: type
props.description: `'globe'` | `'mercator'` | `'vertical-perspective'`, or an interpolating expression.

props.name: sky
props.description: The maplibre sky specification (`sky-color`, `horizon-blend`, `fog-color`, …).

props.name: source
props.description: Id of a `raster-dem` source.
